Fennick Stone Works v. Harrow Insurance Mutual
Supreme Court of Westmarch
September 9, 2025, Argued; January 20, 2026, Decided
No. S-2240

Reporter
76 Wm.3d 880 *; 2026 Wm. LEXIS 21 **
FENNICK STONE WORKS, Appellant, v. HARROW INSURANCE MUTUAL, Respondent.

Prior History: Appeal from the Court of Appeals of Westmarch, First District.

Disposition: Reversed and remanded.

Judges: ODUYA, J., announced the judgment of the Court and delivered an opinion, in which MARROW and FENN, JJ., joined. TRASK, J., concurred in the judgment only. BELLWEATHER, C.J., and HOLLIS, J., dissented.

Opinion by: ODUYA

Opinion

[*882] Fennick Stone Works sued its insurer for breach of a commercial property policy. The trial court granted summary judgment to the insurer.

An insurer that denies coverage without investigating the claim forfeits its right to enforce the policy's appraisal clause. Because Harrow denied the claim on the day it was filed, the appraisal clause does not bar this suit.

[*884] The judgment is reversed and the case is remanded.
